text:
Ari (People Ops): quick idea Redwood Minutes: 1-2 minute audio shoutouts recorded by folks, stitched into a 5-min episode we share on Recognition Day + play in offices. low-effort, human, good for async teams. thoughts? :microphone:
Sam (Comms): love it. audio feels personal. we should offer a script prompt and an option to remain anonymous. also caption/transcript for accessibility.
Noelle (People Ops): good call on transcript. need opt-in consent for publishing externally/internal only? Jae, any legal concerns with recorded staff shoutouts being shared internally?
Jae (Legal): internal sharing fine with consent. include a single checkbox on the recording form: "I consent to internal distribution of this recording." If we plan any external use, require explicit opt-in. Also check local voice recording laws (one-party vs two-party).
Ravi (Eng Tools): we can spin up a simple recorder page (mobile friendly) that uploads MP3 to S3 and auto-generates a rough transcript via ASR. I can prototype in ~3 days. Will include a short trimming UI.
Lena (Office Ops): for in-office folks we can set up a 10-min recording booth during Recognition Week (meeting room + laptop + mic). Volunteers can help.
hr-bot: Reminder: please log recordings in the Gifts & Distribution doc if any physical gear is provided. https://drive.company/gifts
Sam (Comms): distribution plan: Slack post with episode link, short writeup, and timestamps; add an audio player to the intranet homepage during the week. Also encourage sharing in team meetings.
Ari (People Ops): timeline idea: finalize script prompts + consent copy by Apr 10, launch recorder Apr 12, collect clips Apr 12-21, publish Apr 24 (Recognition Day). Can we target that?
Ravi (Eng Tools): yes. will include transcript pipeline and S3 retention policy. Also add a flag to exclude names if someone wants anonymous post.
Noelle (People Ops): action items: (1) Sam draft prompt + post copy (2) Jae finalize consent language (3) Ravi prototype recorder + transcript (4) Lena book rooms + volunteers. I'll create a simple signup for folks who want to record in-office.
Sam (Comms): will draft copy + sample promo by EOD tomorrow.
Jae (Legal): will add recommended consent checkbox wording and a short note on regional recording rules by Apr 8.
Lena (Office Ops): will reserve rooms Apr 12-14 and make a volunteer signup.
Ari (People Ops): sweet. if anyone has concerns about privacy or technical accessibility, flag here and we'll adjust. thanks team! :headphones:
